name: 45817 · Bluffton, OH
findings: ZIP 45817 (Bluffton) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45817 (Bluffton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45817 (Bluffton) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 67% of all organizations here have no identified type.
